summary: Robo.ai Inc., a UAE-based, Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (formerly NWTN), furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, reporting that on November 2, 2026 it appointed Ralph R. Debbas (also spelled Ralf) as Group President, effective immediately. No price, stake, premium, consideration, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory timeline is disclosed; the release is a routine executive appointment press release with no forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure as the triggering event. What to watch: operational execution commentary around the UAE industrial strategy rather than any deal or capital-structure event; nothing actionable on a risk-arb angle.
